# CANDIDATE: AFTERNOON_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After the lunchtime lull, SPY often exhibits a mean-reverting pullback to the VWAP before resuming the afternoon trend, providing a low‑risk long entry. This edge exists because institutional algos tend to re‑anchor to VWAP post‑lunch, and retail‑driven midday chop creates a temporary disconnection from fair value.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Between 13:00 and 14:30 ET, if price is below the session VWAP by at least 0.2% and the 5‑minute RSI is below 45, enter long at the close of the 5‑minute bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop is the recent swing low (previous 5‑minute low) or 0.5% ATR below entry, whichever is tighter. Primary target is at 1.5R or at VWAP plus 0.1% (slight overshoot). After achieving 1R profit, activate a chandelier exit trail to let a runner extend.  
**Regime filter:** Only consider entries when the morning trend is established (price above opening VWAP) and VIX < 22; avoid entries when VWAP is frequently violated (choppy midday).
